sentences.en: An opinion is shocking only if it is a conviction.
sentences.zh: 一个观点只有在它是坚定信念的情况下才会令人震惊。

sentences.en: If you touch that wire, you will receive a shock.
sentences.zh: 如果你碰了那根电线，你会受到电击。

sentences.en: If he should hear the news, he would be shocked.
sentences.zh: 如果他听到这个消息，他会感到震惊的。

senses.zh: 休克；震惊；震动；打击；禾束堆
